title: Max and the Red Ball
text:
Tom has a small dog. The dog is named Max. Every morning, Tom takes Max to the park. They walk under big green trees.

One day, Max found a red ball in the grass. Tom threw the ball, and Max ran fast to catch it. Tom and Max were very happy.

questions.text: What is the name of Tom's dog?
What did Max find in the grass?
How does Tom probably feel about Max?

options: He wants to catch the ball

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people walk and play
the green plant that covers the ground in a garden or field
feeling good because something nice has happened
the early part of the day, before noon

paragraph_translations: Tom'un küçük bir köpeği var. Köpeğin adı Max. Her sabah Tom, Max'i parka götürür. Büyük, yeşil ağaçların altında yürürler.
Bir gün Max çimenlerin içinde kırmızı bir top buldu. Tom topu attı ve Max onu yakalamak için hızlıca koştu. Tom ve Max çok mutluydu.
